text: 下面进入大作文 07 · 2024 英一母题（图文混合）：公园飙升与民生生态建设，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【2024 真题首段 · 两句合并图表与图画】先把公园数量 406、532、670 写清，再用 Meanwhile 切入健身区市民点赞：

As is clearly revealed by the bar chart, the number of parks in a Chinese city surged remarkably from 406 in 2020 to 532 in 2021, and further climbed to 670 in 2022. Meanwhile, the accompanying picture depicts residents exercising happily in a neighborhood fitness area.
手术刀点拨：千万别分开两段描述图表和图画！一句图表、一句 Meanwhile 图画、一句 Together 合龙，55 词刚刚好。
【二段抽屉 · 政府投资便利市民】表达“市政府加大绿地投入，使市民在家门口放松锻炼极其方便”：
In the first place, it is widely acknowledged that municipal governments have increased public investment in green spaces, making it remarkably convenient for citizens to relax and work out nearby.
手术刀点拨：同时运用 it is widely acknowledged that 和 , making it remarkably convenient for ... to do，句式饱满严谨。
【二段升华 + 尾段】用 Not only do these pocket parks 点出美化社区与幸福感，再用 Only by 收束：

Not only do these pocket parks beautify urban neighborhoods, but they also foster harmonious community relations and boost public happiness. Only by prioritizing ecological construction and public well-being can we build more livable and vibrant cities.
手术刀点拨：2024 混合新题型属正向民生类，套用蓝图 A + 政府与个人双抽屉，稳入 17+ 第一档。
